boxes.meaning: still, just the same as before

english.note: Use this when something continues unchanged or is done just as before, rather than emphasizing equal extent.
Use this when an action or outcome goes ahead just the same despite the circumstances.

examples.english: It had been raining for so long, but they still went out running the same way.
examples.traditional: 落咗咁耐雨，佢照樣出去跑步。
examples.jyutping: lok6 zo2 gam3 noi6 jyu5 keoi5 ziu3 joeng6 ceot1 heoi3 paau2 bou6

examples.english: No one came with me, but I nonetheless went travelling on my own.
examples.traditional: 冇人陪我去，我照樣自己去旅行。
examples.jyutping: mou5 jan4 pui4 ngo5 heoi3 ngo5 ziu3 joeng6 zi6 gei2 heoi3 leoi5 hang4
